title: This annoying website
description: If a Gashapon and the DVD bouncing logo had a child you would get this website. Stack is React, TypeScript and Vite. I use pretext for animations. I collect here all my relevant projects. Tap (if you can) on a floating capsule for accessing links.

title: linearama
description: Linearama is a note-taking app for iOS. It's markdown based, local first and supports syncing between devices. It's built in Swift.

title: kowalski
description: Kowalski is an open-source AI powered note-taking app for Android. It eventually evolved into Linearama. It's based on kowalski-core, a personal knowledge management system written in Go.

title: julien
description: Juliene is a small script to download Boiler Room dj sets as m4a from YouTube.

title: tui-network
description: tui-network is a Python based TUI for managing the wifi on Linux built with Textual. And you can read classic fortune quotes on the side, while waiting for the list of networks to refresh.

title: esports-stats-website
description: esports-stats-website is a streamlit web-app to evaluate and compare League of Legends pro players, similarly to FBRef. It also lets you query the data in sql. It sources data from Oracle's Elixir website.

title: Doink!
description: Doink! was a 2D game for Android. You can play with a friend on the same device, using half of the screen each. It's made in Lua, I developed it as part of a hackathon with some friends back in university.
